Per-region scale of pooled null scores

Source: R/caller.R
pool_scale.Rd

Median and MAD (mad(), normal-consistent) of the pooled best LLR (the max over the states' cl_<state> of pool_scores(), i.e. the raw s_comb) over the null pools of each region. Pooled scores standardised with it, (s - med) / mad, put every region of a class on one scale, so a per-class pooled threshold neither over-calls regions whose null pools are shifted or wide (molecule-poor regions where the non-carriers of a pool add little negative LLR, shared depth / phasing artefacts, cell-type specific depth in kNN neighbourhoods) nor ignores quiet ones. The state stays the likelihood argmax. A region with fewer than min_pools null pools takes the class medians; MADs are floored at mad_floor x the class median MAD.

Usage

pool_scale(
  ps,
  states = caller_states("normal"),
  min_pools = 30,
  mad_floor = 0.1,
  tail_q = 0,
  tail_k = 100,
  n_eff = Inf
)

Arguments

ps

pooled null scores (pool_scores() output with region, class, cl_<state>)

states

state set

min_pools

minimal null pools of a region

mad_floor

floor of a region's MAD relative to its class median

tail_q

quantile of the per-region tail factor (0 = no tail factor)

tail_k

shrinkage pseudo-count of the tail factor (effective pools)

n_eff

effective number of independent null pools per region (caps n_pools in the shrinkage weight)

Value

data.table region, class, n_pools, med, mad (+ tail, u_tail when tail_q > 0)

Details

Tail factor (tail_q > 0, off by default): the median / MAD standardise the body of a region's null pools, but a heavy-tailed region keeps collecting calls at a per-class threshold. Each region's null pools are standardised by its med / mad, u_r = their type-7 tail_q quantile and u_c = the median of u_r over the class's regions with at least min_pools pools. With ne = min(n_pools, n_eff) (overlapping kNN pools: one per cell, so the effective number of independent pools is ~ cells / pool size) and w = ne / (ne + tail_k), tail = exp(w log(u_r / u_c)); tail = 1 when u_r or u_c is not positive or the region has fewer than min_pools pools. pool_scores() / pool_combine() then divide by mad x tail.
